title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Has Been Released: Rebel Wolves' Dark Fantasy RPG Is Now Available
summary: Rebel Wolves' debut game, The Blood of Dawnwalker, was released on September 3, 2026, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The game received a major update on launch day, while the development team continues working on performance improvements and player feedback following the release.
content:
Developed by Rebel Wolves, The Blood of Dawnwalker officially launched on September 3, 2026, following a long development period. Published by Bandai Namco, the game was released on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

The game's release also marked an important milestone for Poland-based Rebel Wolves. The Blood of Dawnwalker is the studio's first game and has attracted attention because the team includes developers who previously worked on major projects such as The Witcher series and Cyberpunk 2077 at CD Projekt Red.

Before the release of The Blood of Dawnwalker, the development team shared numerous gameplay videos, developer diaries, and technical details about the game. During an extensive presentation in April, the game's world, characters, gameplay systems, and the impact of player choices on the story were shown in greater detail.

After the September 3 release date was announced, preparations for the launch accelerated. Shortly before release, Bandai Namco also published the game's launch trailer. This gave players a closer look at the central story, characters, and dark atmosphere of the game.

A major update was also released on launch day. The update was intended to deliver the final adjustments and various improvements prepared by the development team before launch. This reflects how modern large-scale games often rely not only on their main game files but also on additional updates released on launch day as part of the release process.

The Blood of Dawnwalker was developed using Unreal Engine 5. Rebel Wolves built the game's world as a large open-world environment, with a particular focus on atmosphere, environmental design, characters, and lighting.

The story takes place in 14th-century Europe, in a region called Vale Sangora in the Carpathian Mountains. Players control a character named Coen. The conflict between humans and vampires plays an important role in Coen's story, and the decisions made by the player can affect how the adventure progresses.

One of the important characters in the game's main story is the vampire lord Brencis. Events surrounding Coen's family and the region where he lives pull him directly into this major conflict. Throughout the story, players do more than simply participate in battles. They also build relationships with different characters and must decide which quests to complete first because of the limited amount of time available.

One of the game's notable systems is its time mechanic. Certain events in the story have limited time windows in which they can take place. As a result, players may not be able to complete every quest or event at the same time. Choosing one quest can cause another event to develop differently. This system is designed to increase replayability and allow different players to experience different story outcomes.

The Blood of Dawnwalker was not designed simply as a traditional vampire-hunting game. Coen's story allows the player to use abilities connected to both the human and vampire sides of his character. This affects not only combat but also exploration and the way certain quests can be approached.

The game's publisher is Bandai Namco Entertainment, while its developer is Rebel Wolves. With The Blood of Dawnwalker, Rebel Wolves has introduced the first chapter of its newly created universe to players. The studio was founded by experienced developers who previously worked at major RPG developer CD Projekt Red.

The release of The Blood of Dawnwalker also brings an end to the game's long promotional period. Since its initial announcement, the game has attracted attention from RPG fans, particularly because of its dark fantasy setting, vampire theme, and time-based systems.

During presentations held before release, the developers explained that they wanted players to be able to make their own decisions within the world and have the story change based on those choices. Because of this, the quest system is not simply about completing a list of objectives; it also depends on which events the player chooses to prioritize.

The release of The Blood of Dawnwalker marks the beginning of a new era for Rebel Wolves. The studio's first game can now be experienced by players, and the future of its newly created universe will continue to take shape alongside the game's post-launch development.

For now, one thing is certain: The Blood of Dawnwalker is no longer simply an announced RPG project. As of September 3, 2026, it has officially been released on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

faq.question: Is The Blood of Dawnwalker a new game in The Witcher series?
faq.answer: No. The Blood of Dawnwalker is a completely new intellectual property developed by Rebel Wolves. However, there is a connection between the two projects through members of the development team who previously worked on The Witcher games.

faq.question: When was The Blood of Dawnwalker released?
faq.answer: The game was released on September 3, 2026. The announced platforms are PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

faq.question: Which studio developed The Blood of Dawnwalker?
faq.answer: The game was developed by Rebel Wolves. It was released as the studio's first game. Bandai Namco Entertainment is responsible for publishing the game.

faq.question: Which engine does The Blood of Dawnwalker use?
faq.answer: The game was developed using Unreal Engine 5. The engine was used to create the game's large world, environmental details, and visual effects.

faq.question: Can you become a vampire in the game?
faq.answer: Coen's story is directly connected to vampires. Throughout the story, players encounter vampire powers and abilities connected to the human side of the character. These powers can affect both the story and the way the game is played.

faq.question: Do player choices matter in the game?
faq.answer: Yes. Player choices are an important part of the game's core design. The outcome of certain quests and events can change depending on previous decisions and how the player chooses to spend their limited time.

faq.question: Can all quests be completed in a single playthrough?
faq.answer: Because of the game's time system, players are not expected to experience every event at the same time. Some choices can cause other events to develop differently, meaning a single playthrough is not designed to reveal every possible outcome.

faq.question: Is The Blood of Dawnwalker a single-player game?
faq.answer: The game's core structure is built around a single-player action RPG experience. Players progress through Coen's story while making their own decisions.

faq.question: Is The Blood of Dawnwalker an open-world game?
faq.answer: Yes. The game takes place in Vale Sangora, a large open-world region that players can explore. The world contains different quests, characters, locations, and story events.

faq.question: Where does the story take place?
faq.answer: The story takes place in 14th-century Europe, in the Vale Sangora region of the Carpathian Mountains. The area's dark atmosphere and the presence of vampires are among the central elements of the story.

faq.question: What will happen after the release of The Blood of Dawnwalker?
faq.answer: With the game's launch, Rebel Wolves completed the first major stage of its development process. Following the launch-day update, the team continues working on player feedback and technical improvements. Details about future updates and development will depend on official announcements from the developer and publisher.
